Open a text field on the TV first (e.g. search or password).

Live TV (IPTV)

Xtream Codes login

YouTube subscriptions

Import your subscriptions: go to takeout.google.com, choose only "YouTube and YouTube Music" → "subscriptions", download and choose the file subscriptions.csv here. No login on the TV needed.

YouTube account (optional)

Sign in to youtube.com in your browser, export the cookies as cookies.txt (e.g. with the extension "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY") and choose the file here. Repeat for more accounts.

Network drive

Troubleshooting

The box's logs as one file, to send to whoever helps you. Passwords and logins are removed. For more details: turn on Settings → System → Troubleshooting log on the TV, make the problem happen, then download.
